current.headline: Business Rivalries finale — a free Nightclub, 2X Nightclub goods, and $1,000,000 for selling from any business.
current.summary: Ordered best first. Do the Weekly Challenge first: sell $1,000,000 from whichever business is fullest and it pays another $1,000,000 on top. Then claim the free Nightclub and, if you did any of the last three challenges, the free La Coureuse — both are gone after Wednesday.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$ and RP — Nightclub Goods Missions
bonuses.detail: Started from Yohan in the Nightclub. They top up the basement stock, which is what you sell towards the $1M challenge. Pairs with the free Elysian Island club if you do not own one yet.

bonuses.title: 2X Popularity — Nightclub Management Missions
bonuses.detail: Keeps the club near full popularity, which is what sets the safe income: $50,000 per in-game day (48 minutes) at 95% and above, falling to $10,000 around half popularity.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$ and RP — QuickiePharm Deliveries
bonuses.detail: Quick drop-offs, no property needed. Good filler between sales.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$ and RP — Featured Series
bonuses.detail: Deadline, Deadline Duet and Tiny Racers. Only if you fancy the modes.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$ and RP — Community Combat Series
bonuses.detail: Player-made deathmatches. Lowest value on the list.

claims.title: Weekly Challenge — sell $1,000,000 across all businesses
claims.detail: Any business counts — cargo, Bunker, MC, Acid Lab or Nightclub. Pays $1,000,000 plus the Retro Fruit Tracksuit, on top of the sale itself. The last $1M challenge of the event.

claims.title: Free Elysian Island Nightclub
claims.detail: Through Maze Bank Foreclosures until 30 September. On its own it produces no stock — the basement fills from the other businesses you own.

claims.title: Free Penaud La Coureuse with a free HSW upgrade
claims.detail: If you finished any Weekly Challenge between 3 and 23 September. Claim it at Legendary Motorsport this week; the HSW upgrade is on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC Enhanced.

claims.title: Prize Ride — Pegassi Zorrusso
claims.detail: Win an LS Car Meet Series race four days in a row.

claims.title: Lucky Wheel podium — Ocelot Penetrator
claims.detail: One spin a day at the Diamond Casino, two for GTA+ members.

claims.title: Business Battle crates pay guaranteed clothing
claims.detail: Cosmetic only — Six Figure Tee, Ride or Die Tee, red and white Ammu-Nation Cap or Bourgeoix Tee.

claims.title: GTA+ — Tactical SMG 30% off at the Gun Van
claims.detail: Plus a second daily Lucky Wheel spin.

current.discounts_lead: The free Nightclub plus all 16 discounted vehicles, biggest saving first. The Arbiter GT at 70% off is the only deep cut — everything else is 30% off.

discounts.name: Declasse Drift Yosemite
discounts.meta: Muscle · LS Car Meet test ride

discounts.name: Vapid GB200
discounts.meta: Sports · LS Car Meet test ride

current.gun_van: Battle Rifle is this week's featured discount, and the Tactical SMG is 30% off for GTA+. Also stocked: Combat Shotgun, Minigun, Combat Pistol, Switchblade, Tear Gas, Molotovs and Pipe Bombs. Moves daily at 07:00 UK time.

wk.headline: 3X on the Community Mission Series, plus two free-car chances.
wk.summary: A quieter week between events. Best value was the Community Series multiplier and a couple of claimable cars.

bonuses.title: 3X GTA$ and RP — Community Mission Series
bonuses.detail: All week.

claims.title: Podium Vehicle — Übermacht Cypher
claims.detail: Daily Casino spin. Normally $1,550,000 at Legendary Motorsport.

claims.title: Claimable Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio
claims.detail: Free this week — check the in-game conditions.

claims.title: Chance to unlock the Karin Boor for free
claims.detail: Claimable this week — check the in-game conditions.

wk.headline: Panther Statue guaranteed on Cayo Perico, plus a free $1,000,000 for logging in.
wk.summary: Second week of the Summer Heist Event. Guaranteed top-value Cayo Perico loot and a big login giveaway.

bonuses.title: Weekly completion bonuses reset
bonuses.detail: Bigger first-time payout across every Heist and Contact Mission except Cayo Perico.

claims.title: Panther Statue guaranteed — Cayo Perico Heist Finale
claims.detail: 100% spawn chance on your first completion this week. Also unlocks the Panther Tour Jacket.

claims.title: End of Summer Giveaway
claims.detail: Log in between 6–12 August for $1,000,000 within 72 hours, plus two cosmetics.

claims.title: Cayo Perico Survival — three waves
claims.detail: Noise Rockstar Logo Aged Tee plus $100,000.

claims.title: Assault on Cayo Perico and Cayo Perico Zombie Survival return
claims.detail: Both pay bonus rewards this week.

wk.headline: Brand Wars kicks off — 4X on Hotring Circuit and Freemode, big Twitch Drops running.
wk.summary: First week of the two-week Sprunk vs eCola event. Free branded gear just for logging in, plus reset completion bonuses.

bonuses.title: 4X GTA$ and RP — Hotring Circuit Series and Freemode Events
bonuses.detail: Runs through 26 August.

bonuses.title: 3X GTA$ and RP — Odd Jobs and Community Series
bonuses.detail: Paper Route, Firefighter, Forklift Operator, QuickiePharm and Safeguard Deliveries.

bonuses.title: Heist and Mission completion bonuses reset
bonuses.detail: Bigger first-time payout across a range of Heists and Contact Missions.

claims.title: Weekly Challenge — three Business Battles
claims.detail: Impotent Rage Sweatsuit plus a 2.5X reward of $250,000.

claims.title: Free Declasse Hotring Sabre
claims.detail: Sprunk x eCola livery and branded plates. Log in any time through 26 August.

claims.title: Free Sprunk and eCola bodysuits
claims.detail: Clothing stores around the city, for the event's duration.

claims.title: Brand Wars Twitch Drops begin
claims.detail: Link Twitch and Rockstar accounts, pick a side. Up to $2,000,000 total through 26 August.

wk.headline: Brand Wars finale — 5X GTA$ and RP on VIP Work, plus a reset Kortz Center bonus.
wk.summary: Second half of the two-week Brand Wars event. Big VIP Work weekend, Kortz Center resets with a no-death bonus, and the Warden goes on general sale.

bonuses.title: 5X GTA$ and RP — VIP Work
bonuses.detail: Weekend only, 21–23 August.

bonuses.title: 4X GTA$ and RP — Hotring Circuit Series and select Freemode
bonuses.detail: Runs the full week.

bonuses.title: Kortz Center Heist bonus reset
bonuses.detail: New Primary Targets. A no-death completion adds an extra $400,000.

claims.title: Weekly Challenge — win three Races
claims.detail: Princess Racing Tracksuit plus a 2.5X reward of $250,000.

claims.title: Gallivanter Warden now on general sale
claims.detail: $1,597,500 at Legendary Motorsport.

claims.title: FIB Priority File — The Brute Force File
claims.detail: Pays more than the standard files.

claims.title: Brand Wars Twitch Drops close out
claims.detail: Link Twitch and Rockstar accounts. Up to $2,000,000 total across the full event.

wk.headline: Auto Shop Robbery Contracts pay double all week.
wk.summary: Everything else boosted was racing. Contracts were the money, with a flat $100k drift challenge alongside.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$, RP and Car Meet Rep — Auto Shop Robbery Contracts
bonuses.detail: The only real money on the boosted list. Back-to-back contracts ran near $700k an hour.

bonuses.title: 3X GTA$ and RP — Random Transform Races
bonuses.detail: Known Unknowns and Unknown Unknowns playlists. Five new races added.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$ and RP — Drift Races
bonuses.detail: Doubled Car Meet Rep too, which sped up the Prize Ride.

bonuses.title: 6X GTA$ and RP — select Drift and Transform Races
bonuses.detail: Weekend window only, 28–30 August.

claims.title: Weekly Challenge — three Drift Races for $100,000
claims.detail: You only needed to take part; winning was not required.

claims.title: Free Glitch Camo drift livery
claims.detail: Finish a Drift Race in the Übermacht Cypher. The livery arrives within 72 hours.

claims.title: Lucky Wheel podium — Karin Sultan Classic
claims.detail: Normally $1,718,000, or a $1,288,500 trade price for finishing the Diamond Casino Heist finale as leader with it as the getaway car.

claims.title: Prize Ride — Dinka Veto Classic
claims.detail: Top 5 in the Car Meet Series for four consecutive days.

claims.title: FIB Priority File — The Fine Art File
claims.detail: The boosted weekly FIB File.

claims.title: GTA+ — free Gallivanter Warden
claims.detail: Also 2X FIB Files and 60% off the Garment Factory.

wk.gun_van: 30% off the Military Rifle. Stock included the Railgun, Grenade Launcher, Heavy Pistol, Crowbar, Pipe Bombs, Tear Gas and Grenades.

wk.headline: Business Rivalries opened with Executive week — a free office and $1,000,000 for shifting cargo.
wk.summary: The cargo run was the week: a full warehouse sold for about $2.22M and the challenge paid another $1,000,000 on top. The free office unlocked both.

bonuses.title: Special Cargo staff sourcing at double speed
bonuses.detail: The week's real earner. Sourcing at double speed fills a large warehouse in roughly half the usual time. All 111 crates sell for about $2,220,000, near enough $1,554,000 clear once you account for the buy cost, and about half as much again if you sell from a public session.

bonuses.title: 4X GTA$ and RP — Special Vehicle Work
bonuses.detail: Best rate per minute on the list. Base pay is about $20–35k a mission, so 4X lands between $80k and $140k. Needs an Executive Office and a Vehicle Warehouse, and four Vehicle Cargo missions to unlock it.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$ and RP — Madrazo Hits
bonuses.detail: From the Agency. $20,000 base, $30,000 if you kill the target with Madrazo's weapon of choice, doubled this week. Good filler while crate buys are on cooldown.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$ and RP — Export Mixed Goods
bonuses.detail: Run from the assistant in your Executive Office. Worth doing on the way past rather than making a trip for.

bonuses.title: 3X GTA$ and RP — Community Mission Series
bonuses.detail: Player-made jobs, no property needed. Base pay differs job to job, so treat 3X as a bonus on something you fancied playing rather than a target to grind.

bonuses.title: 2X GTA$ and RP — Diamond Adversary Series
bonuses.detail: Lowest value on the list. Only if you fancy the mode.

claims.title: Weekly Challenge — sell $1,000,000 of Special Cargo
claims.detail: A 10X reward of $1,000,000 plus the Yeti x LS Customs Tracksuit, and it stacks on top of the sale itself. A full 111-crate warehouse clears the target in one sale.

claims.title: Free Arcadius Business Center office
claims.detail: Free through Dynasty 8 Executive before 9 September, normally $2,250,000. Claim it first — it is what unlocks the 4X Special Vehicle Work and the cargo challenge above.

claims.title: Free Penaud La Coureuse with a free HSW upgrade
claims.detail: Finish at least one Weekly Challenge across the next three weeks. Delivered when you play between 24 and 30 September. Normally $1,990,000.

claims.title: Lucky Wheel podium — Declasse Impaler SZ
claims.detail: One spin per day at the Diamond Casino. Normally $1,280,000 at Southern S.A. Super Autos.

claims.title: Prize Ride — Woodlander
claims.detail: Won through the Car Meet Series, as usual.

claims.title: Business Battle crates pay guaranteed clothing
claims.detail: Cosmetic only — Six Figure Tee, Ride or Die Tee, red and white Ammu-Nation Cap or Bourgeoix Tee.

claims.title: GTA+ — 2X on FIB Files and 3X on Drift Races
claims.detail: Plus 60% off the Garment Factory, all through 9 September.

wk.discounts_lead: All 17 discounted vehicles, biggest saving first, plus the free office. The Cyclone II at 70% off was the only deep cut.
wk.gun_van: The featured deal was the Precision Rifle at 50% off, $225,000 down from $450,000.

wk.headline: Business Rivalries week two — Motorcycle Clubs and the Acid Lab.
wk.summary: Not pulled in at the time. The one confirmed item was the $1,000,000 Weekly Challenge.

claims.title: Weekly Challenge — sell $1,000,000 of MC Business or Acid Lab product
claims.detail: Paid $1,000,000 plus the Junk Tracksuit, and counted towards the free Penaud La Coureuse.

wk.headline: Business Rivalries week three — Bunkers.
wk.summary: Not pulled in at the time. The confirmed items were the Bunker challenge and the Kortz Center reset.

claims.title: Weekly Challenge — three Bunker Research Missions
claims.detail: Paid $1,000,000 plus the Camo Ammu-Nation Sweatsuit, and counted towards the free Penaud La Coureuse.

claims.title: Kortz Center Heist reset
claims.detail: New Primary Targets and a reset first-completion bonus. Finishing without dying added $400,000.
